"Clean things up" could mean a lot of different jobs, and the rules I'm working under treat unrequested cleanup as exactly the kind of change that's cheap to generate and expensive to review — so I'd rather aim before touching anything. Let me take one read-only look so I can ask you a concrete question instead of a vague one.

TOOL: git status
TOOL: git log --oneline -8
TOOL: ls -A

(The results will come back in your next message; I won't edit anything until you tell me which job you actually want.)
